final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.birth_country AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS n FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS t FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c AS c, s1.n AS n, s1.n * 1.0 / s2.t AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.t IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.c, s3.n, s3.share, s3.n - s4.a AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.n > s4.a) SELECT SUM(n), AVG(share), AVG(d) FROM s5
